policy: For unresolved game-profile suffixes, confirm the digital variant meaning from the official profile key / public game roster first, then map only to the narrowest physical family actually supported. Opaque internal selectors remain unresolved and do not force an exact physical release.

physical_family_candidates.name: Han Solo, Stormtrooper Disguise, Black Eyes
Han Solo, Stormtrooper Disguise, White Pupils

records.reason: The game publicly exposes Han Solo (Stormtrooper) and a separate no-helmet variant. The internal suffix B is not a documented physical-release selector, so it may distinguish a game-local asset/state and must not select one catalog release by score alone.

Jango Fett (Clone) is an explicit Skywalker Saga game variant, but none of the supported physical Jango Fett catalog names identify a Clone variant. Preserve it as a digital appearance/state variant rather than choosing Black Head, Santa, or gray-torso physical releases.

Jango Fett (Casual) is an explicit Skywalker Saga variant. The current physical catalog candidates do not contain a Casual Jango identity, so lexical ranking across normal/Santa/torso variants cannot establish an exact physical counterpart.

physical_family_candidates.name: Princess Leia / General Leia, Plain Undershirt
Princess Leia / General Leia, Dark Tan Turtle-neck

records.reason: The game roster contains General Leia and a Bandaged Leia state, but the current catalog candidates only establish the General Leia family and do not independently identify a bandaged physical release. Keep the bandaged story-state separate from exact physical version resolution.
